panels.description: Current total request rate for the selected host.
panels.title: Total Request Rate

panels.description: Share of responses with an HTTP 4xx status. Dominated by 404s, so a jump usually means broken links or a scanner.

targets.expr:
(
  sum(count_over_time({service="nginx", env="$env", host="$host", log_type="access", status=~"4.."}[$__interval]))
  or vector(0)
) /
sum(count_over_time({service="nginx", env="$env", host="$host", log_type="access"}[$__interval]))

panels.title: 4xx Ratio

panels.description: Share of responses with an HTTP 5xx status. A ratio stays meaningful when overall traffic changes.

targets.expr:
(
  sum(count_over_time({service="nginx", env="$env", host="$host", log_type="access", status=~"5.."}[$__interval]))
  or vector(0)
) /
sum(count_over_time({service="nginx", env="$env", host="$host", log_type="access"}[$__interval]))

panels.title: 5xx Ratio
